title: Add two mapper onComplete method to Future.java
body:
#### Describe the feature

Currently the compose method has a two mapper signature:
```
<U> Future<U> compose(Function<T, Future<U>> successMapper, Function<Throwable, Future<U>> failureMapper);
```
Where you supply the success and failure mappers separately.

It would be useful if there was a similar signature for the `onComplete` method, rather than calling `onSuccess` and `onFailure` separately.

My proposal is to add a new `onComplete` signature here:
https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/compare/master...samuel-hawker:vert.x:poc?expand=1
That simply calls onSuccess and onFailure like so:
```
 default Future<T> onComplete(Handler<T> successHandler, Handler<Throwable> failureHandler) {
      return onSuccess(successHandler).onFailure(failureHandler);
  }
```

#### Use cases
The use case would be when a user wants to provide two separate handlers, but does not want to use the compose method as there is no need to return anything.

#### Contribution

Who should implement this feature ? me (see POC change above)
